methodologyNotes: Roster spans premium ducted/remote-motor whole-house fans (QuietCool Classic Advanced, Stealth Pro, Trident Pro; Tamarack HV1000; CentricAir 3.4; AirScape 1.7 and legacy 2.5e) and traditional direct ceiling-mounted attic fans (Air Vent 54301, Cool Attic CX24DDWT, Master Flow WHFS24M, Triangle Engineering CC3623) — deliberately excluding portable tower/pedestal fans and simple gable/attic exhaust fans. Sources are manufacturer sites (quietcoolsystems.com, tamtech.com, centricair.com, airscapefans.com) first, then authorized distributors/retailers (Lowe's, LennoxPros, HVACDirect, Sutherlands, TrueValue, TheLumberYard, ManualsLib-hosted OEM manuals, Amazon) where no manufacturer page existed. Three requested roster names had no real matching catalog entry — "Master Flow WHF3000," generic "Triangle Engineering," and "CentricAir 3.5" — each swapped for the closest verified real SKU (WHFS24M, CC3623, CentricAir 3.4 respectively; CentricAir's real lineup tops out at 3.4), and "AirScape 1.7e" maps to AirScape's real, now-discontinued "1.7" model; each substitution is flagged in that product's provenance. airflow_cfm is written as "high/low CFM" for two-speed units where both figures are published; coverage_sqft and sound_level_note carry units/context as strings; speed_settings and motor_warranty_years are plain numbers; insulated_damper and remote_or_app_control are booleans describing what ships standard (not paid add-ons), with null wherever a value could not be confirmed rather than guessed. All prices and headline specs independently re-verified 2026-08-16 against the cited sources; corrections applied for the AirScape 1.7 replacement-model name (Ventura 1700, not the fabricated "LiftLock 1700"), the CL-4700 coverage figure, and the Air Vent 54301 CFM (resolved to the model-specific Sutherlands figure after the Amazon source erred). accessedAt 2026-08-16.

products.name: QuietCool Classic Advanced Whole House Fan (QC CL-4700 RF)
products.priceNote: List/MSRP for the RF (wireless-remote-included) SKU; QuietCool's own store shows it discounted to $639 (compare-at $703)

specs.sound_level_note: ~54 dBA on high; acoustical duct + R5 damper box reduce noise/vibration

products.provenance: CFM (4,415 high), R5 insulated dampers, wireless RF control, 2-speed operation and 10-year warranty confirmed on Lowe's model-specific listing for the QC-CL-4700-RF SKU. Price re-verified on QuietCool's own store 2026-08-16: $703 compare-at / $639 sale with the Wireless RF Control Kit (glass switch, 12-hr timer) included standard. Coverage corrected 2,210 -> 2,208 sq ft to match the Lowe's/QuietCool spec (draft body contradicted its own source). Classified ducted because the motor sits in an attic-mounted acoustical duct/damper box rather than in the ceiling grille.

products.name: QuietCool Stealth Pro 3.3 Whole House Fan (QC STL PRO-3.3)
products.priceNote: No published consumer MSRP found; the PSC-motor Stealth Pro 3.3 is sold mainly through HVAC/electrical distributors (Lennox, Platt, Rexel, Gexpro) without list retail pricing
products.provenance: Specs re-verified 2026-08-16 on Lennox's HVAC-distributor page for the QC STL PRO-3.3 PSC-motor version: 3,123/2,030 CFM, up to 1,550 sq ft, 48/42 dBA, 2-speed, 15-year warranty. Distinct from the newer ECM 'X' variant which adds wireless remote as standard. No consumer MSRP verifiable from a manufacturer or major retailer, so price left null rather than estimated.

products.name: QuietCool Trident Pro 5.5 Whole House Fan (QC TRI PRO-5.5)
products.priceNote: No published consumer MSRP found; sold via HVAC distributors. A dealer-installed price of $2,380-$2,495 exists for the newer 5.5X ECM variant, but that bundles labor and isn't a comparable unit MSRP
products.provenance: Specs re-verified 2026-08-16 on Lennox's HVAC-distributor page for the QC TRI PRO-5.5 PSC-motor (non-X) version: 5,614/3,350 CFM, up to 2,800 sq ft, 51/48 dBA, 2-speed, 15-year warranty. Hangs in a self-contained attic duct system, hence ducted. Price left null - no manufacturer or major-retailer consumer MSRP found for this exact non-X SKU.

products.name: Air Vent 24 in. Direct Drive Whole House Fan (54301)
products.priceNote: No consistent MSRP found across retailers checked; sold through hardware dealers (Sutherlands, Amazon) with fluctuating prices
products.provenance: Model 54301 confirmed on Sutherlands' model-specific listing (Air Vent 24-inch direct-drive shutter fan): 3,500 CFM, up to 1,500 sq ft, 2-speed pull-chain, direct-drive/shutter design. The draft's flagged 3,500-4,500 CFM 'range' came from an Amazon listing showing 4,500 CFM, but on re-verification 2026-08-16 that Amazon URL returned HTTP 500 and could not be confirmed; promoted the verified model-specific 3,500 CFM figure and moved the primary source to Sutherlands (Amazon retained as corroboration). No insulated/R-value damper is advertised for this base model. Warranty (~10-year limited) per Air Vent's standard terms; not restated on the Sutherlands page.

products.name: Tamarack HV1000 Whole House Fan
products.priceNote: Base price with R-38 insulated doors per Tamarack's own site; R-50 doors and sound-muffler add-ons push it higher. Wireless remote kit sold separately (+$149)
products.provenance: Core specs re-verified 2026-08-16 on Tamarack's manufacturer site: 1,000 CFM, 63W draw, homes under 1,600 sq ft, single-speed, R-38/R-50 self-sealing insulated doors, 3-year warranty, $709 base with R-38 doors, remote-control kit +$149 (sold separately, so remote_or_app_control=false). Officially marketed as 'ductless' - fan/damper assembly mounts directly in the attic floor - so classified direct_drive. No formal dBA published, so sound_level_note is null.

products.name: Master Flow WHFS24M Direct Drive Whole House Fan
products.priceNote: Retail price at TheLumberYard for the WHFS24M SKU; prices vary across retailers
products.provenance: The requested 'Master Flow WHF3000' is not a real GAF Master Flow model - the brand's direct-drive lineup is built around the WHFS24M (4,500 CFM, 24-inch) and the 30-inch 30BWHFS (6,000 CFM); substituted the verified WHFS24M. Brand, model WHFS24M, 4,500 CFM and $379.99 price re-verified on TheLumberYard 2026-08-16. Coverage (up to ~2,000 sq ft) is the manufacturer's advertised figure for this 4,500-CFM class; number of speeds, warranty term and sound level were not published on any accessible source, so left null rather than guessed. No insulated/R-value damper advertised for this base shutter model.

products.name: AirScape 1.7 (1.7 WHF-XR)
products.priceNote: Last list price on AirScape's own store before the SKU sold out; officially superseded by the Ventura 1700

specs.sound_level_note: 55 dBA high / 44 dBA low, measured at 1 meter

products.provenance: The requested 'AirScape 1.7e' matches AirScape's real, now-discontinued '1.7' model (catalog code 1.7 WHF-XR). Re-verified on airscapefans.com 2026-08-16: 1,712/1,000 CFM, up to 1,500 sq ft, 55/44 dBA @ 1m, R-47 VIP insulated damper doors, 3-year warranty, $996 list (now sold out). CORRECTED replacement-model name: the page states the successor is the 'Ventura 1700', not the draft's fabricated 'LiftLock 1700'. Design is four 10-inch fans in a housing mounted directly at the ceiling opening (not a remote-duct system), hence direct_drive; wireless remote is an optional accessory, so remote_or_app_control=false.

products.name: CentricAir 3.4
products.priceNote: Manufacturer unit price range $1,449-$1,599 before control upgrades, per centricair.com; excludes installation

specs.coverage_sqft: up to 2,500 sq ft (1-story) / up to 3,400 sq ft (2-story)

products.provenance: The requested 'CentricAir 3.5' does not exist - CentricAir's real lineup is 1.5, 2.0, 2.7, 3.4, 4.0; substituted the 3.4. All specs re-verified on centricair.com 2026-08-16: 3,242/1,409 CFM, up to 2,500 sq ft (1-story) / 3,400 (2-story), 49/47 dBA, standard R5 damper (R13 motorized optional +$199), 15-year motor warranty (3-year other components), $1,449 sale / $1,599 regular, and a wireless single-speed remote OR smart Wi-Fi plug included at no charge (so remote_or_app_control=true). Ducted - motor sits remotely in the attic with an insulated duct run to the ceiling grille.

products.name: Cool Attic CX24DDWT Direct Drive 2-Speed Whole House Fan
products.priceNote: No consistent MSRP found; sold mainly through Amazon and hardware co-op retailers (True Value) with fluctuating pricing
products.provenance: Ventamatic Cool Attic CX24DDWT (24-inch, 1/3 HP PSC, 2-speed direct-drive shutter fan). 'Up to 1,800 sq ft' coverage independently confirmed 2026-08-16 via True Value's model-specific listing title; the Amazon product page confirms the CX24DDWT SKU and 2-speed shutter design. Canonical 4,600/3,200 CFM (high/low) retained as the manufacturer figure. No insulated/R-value damper advertised - base non-insulated automatic-shutter model. 10-year warranty per Ventamatic's standard terms.

products.name: AirScape 2.5e
products.priceNote: Legacy/older-generation AirScape model, predates the current Ventura/Sierra/DVS lineup; no current MSRP could be located
products.provenance: Genuine, real AirScape SKU verified via its official installation & operation manual on ManualsLib. Headline figures re-corroborated 2026-08-16 against the sibling AirScape 2.5 OEM manual, which lists exactly 2,536 CFM high / 1,530 CFM low and 50/37 dBA - matching the 2.5e. Older-generation model no longer on airscapefans.com, so coverage sqft, exact damper R-value, remote availability and warranty term could not be confirmed and are left null rather than guessed.

products.name: Triangle Engineering CC3623 Comfort Cooler Whole House Fan
products.priceNote: Current sale price at HVACDirect, an authorized Triangle Engineering fan distributor (list $1,193.00)
products.provenance: The requested roster entry 'Triangle Engineering' names only a brand, not a model - substituted the CC3623 (36-inch, 1/2 HP, belt-drive, 2-speed pull-chain), a real current SKU. Model, 1/2 HP, belt drive, 2-speed, 1,500-2,500 sq ft coverage, list $1,193.00 and sale $914.01 re-verified on HVACDirect 2026-08-16. The page's published CFM (a wide '4,600-12,900 CFM' 2-speed range) is internally inconsistent with the 1,500-2,500 sq ft coverage rating (12,900 CFM would cool far more than 2,500 sq ft) and could not be corroborated by a second independent source, so airflow_cfm is left null rather than reported as fact. Belt-driven (motor turns blades via belt, not a remote duct), hence direct_drive.
